title: Tenant switcher
description: Inline disclosure switcher for the sidebar header, no popover: expanding grows the header in place and pushes the nav down; selection is a react-aria ListBox rendered in document flow. Collapsed to the icon rail it becomes a read-only tile showing the active tenant's Blobatar on a squircle backdrop.

anatomy.description: Root with data-slot="tenant-switcher"; props are tenants, activeTenant, onActiveTenantChange (controlled or uncontrolled).
react-aria Button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the panel; shows logo, name, plan and a chevron.
Grid-rows 0fr to 1fr disclosure, inert while closed; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; an outside pointerdown dismisses.
Private react-aria ListBox wrappers with single selection; keyboard navigation and typeahead come from react-aria.
The shared Squircle (its own entry since 2026-09-30, when the Avatar became its second consumer) as the tile's glass backdrop under the Blobatar.

usage: Must render inside SidebarProvider: it reads the collapsed state through useSidebar.
Inline over overlay is the house philosophy for disclosure; do not swap the panel for a popover.

The shell's disclosures are exclusive (useExclusiveDisclosure in src/lib): opening the UserProfile or the dock's More closes the switcher, and opening the switcher closes them, by pointer or keyboard.

ListBox and Squircle were promoted when a second component needed them (Select, then Avatar); useClickOutside lives in src/lib, shared with the UserProfile. Nothing in this directory is private any more except its own CSS.
